# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and asynchronous readback** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces Graphite GPU rendering and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback. Graphite is additive to Ganesh. Its explicit submission model and callback-scoped readback require different integration; an iOS simulator Metal gradient limitation remains.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m152** — Updates the bundled engine to milestone 152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, retaining the Vulkan allocator fallback. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651))

## API Surface

- **Explicit Graphite rendering** — Adds Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, recorders, recordings, texture wrappers, and an image cache. Graphite uses record, snap, insert, and submit; existing Ganesh behavior is unchanged. WebAssembly integrates browser WebGPU through Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels deliver callback-scoped results with copy-out helpers. Raster callbacks run synchronously; Ganesh work must be submitted and drained with GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion. Graphite uses asynchronous rather than synchronous readback. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration** — Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with typed backend-context and extension helpers, and makes GRVkExtensions directly constructible. The SharpVk package remains available; Silk.NET package production is included. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Source and buffer lifetimes corrected** — Region iterators retain their source region; derived pixmaps retain their pixel owner. Failed raster-image creation frees its pixel buffer, uniform Reset disposes the old data, and HarfBuzz blob cleanup disposes consumed non-memory-backed streams. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Native cache cleanup** — Releases the cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owning object, preventing an unlock through freed storage. ([#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## Bug Fixes

- **Less copying on data and text paths** — SKData.SaveTo avoids an intermediate copy on span-capable targets; .NET Framework and netstandard2.0 keep buffered writes. Text encoding, uniform lookup, object wrapping, feature-array shaping, and tag formatting reduce avoidable work. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))
- **Ganesh failure propagation** — Prevents stale readbacks after failed flushes and includes further upstream font-rendering and Ganesh stability corrections. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## Platform

- **Explicit fonts on Nano Server** — The Nano Server native build uses FreeType so fonts loaded from files, streams, or data can render. It still has no system-font manager: applications must load fonts explicitly. Normal Windows DirectWrite builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Native debugging assets** — Produces Apple dSYM symbol packages separately from customer runtime packages and records deterministic Android build IDs for matching split-debug files. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Font.Shape avoids copying caller-owned feature arrays, and Tag.ToString avoids boxing its four characters. Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android build IDs improve native debugging without upgrading the bundled HarfBuzz engine.

## Release Candidate 1 (August 26, 2026)

Reduced feature-array and tag-formatting allocations, fixed uniform-buffer and HarfBuzz blob-stream cleanup, and restored Silk.NET package production. Added Apple symbol packages and deterministic Android symbol identity.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.0-preview.1.1...v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Introduced Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, and explicit font loading on Nano Server. Fixed region, pixmap, and raster-image source lifetimes and reduced data-path overhead.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.5...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
